recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-7135 follow-up is needed unless OO opens a separate future redesign of AOE representation.
issue_request: FHIR-7135 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO change request against DSTU1 DiagnosticOrder.supportingInformation. It asked to fix confusing/error-prone supporting-information wording, correct the inspired carbon dioxide example, and clarify that laboratory ask-at-order-entry answers are discrete referenced resources such as Observations, not free-form narrative.
initial_application: The issue was applied in 2015. Commit 328fda313339a558b3204ddc429689a5656eb64e added AOE aliases/text to DiagnosticOrder.supportingInformation and changed the example to inspired oxygen. Commit 0f465cf0cae245f21f89c609479fab8b674082d8 expanded the DiagnosticOrder example/notes and continued to model the AOE as an Observation referenced by supportingInformation. Later source history renamed DiagnosticOrder to DiagnosticRequest and ultimately subsumed it into ServiceRequest.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ServiceRequest as an active current resource and comments that DiagnosticOrder was subsumed into ServiceRequest. Current ServiceRequest.supportingInfo retains the requested substance: AOEs are named, the producer/filler observation wording is present, and the example is inspired oxygen for blood gas measurements. Later FHIR-31589 clarified the boundary with orderDetail without reversing this guidance, and a 2025 OO Lab minutes page found during reconciliation also treats AOEs required for testing as ServiceRequest.supportingInfo rather than OrderDetail.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scope source already conveys the requested correction and later guidance covers the remaining potential confusion about questions to be gathered versus existing supporting information.

related_jiras.note: Clarified the current ServiceRequest.supportingInfo/orderDetail boundary while preserving the FHIR-7135 supportingInfo definition; it is already represented on the combined branch.
